"""Pygbag entry point for Super Mario Bros"""
import asyncio
import pygame
import sys

# Import everything from mario
from mario import *

async def main():
    global running, state
    
    # Initial state already set by mario.py's module-level code
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS)
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    running = False
                if event.key == pygame.K_RETURN and state == STATE_MENU:
                    reset_game()
                    state = STATE_PLAYING
                if event.key == pygame.K_r and state in (STATE_GAMEOVER, STATE_WIN):
                    reset_game()
                    state = STATE_PLAYING

        # ── MENU ──
        if state == STATE_MENU:
            screen.fill(SKY_COLOR)
            title = big_font.render("SUPER MARIO BROS", True, WHITE)
            start = font.render("Press ENTER to Start", True, WHITE)
            ctrl = font.render("Arrows: Move | Space/Up: Jump", True, WHITE)
            screen.blit(title, (SCREEN_W//2 - title.get_width()//2, 180))
            screen.blit(start, (SCREEN_W//2 - start.get_width()//2, 280))
            screen.blit(ctrl, (SCREEN_W//2 - ctrl.get_width()//2, 330))
            pygame.display.flip()
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
            continue

        # ── PLAYING ──
        if state == STATE_PLAYING:
            if not player.dead:
                solids = get_solids()

                # horizontal movement
                if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
                    player.vx -= PLAYER_ACCEL
                if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
                    player.vx += PLAYER_ACCEL
                if keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP]:
                    player.jump()
                else:
                    if player.jump_held:
                        player.jump_release()

                player.update(solids, SCREEN_W)

                if player.y > SCREEN_H + 100:
                    player.die()
                    if player.dead:
                        lives -= 1
                        if lives <= 0:
                            state = STATE_GAMEOVER
                        else:
                            state = STATE_DEATH
                            death_timer = 90

                camera.update(player.x, player.y, LEVEL_W_TILES * TILE)

                # ── enemy update ──
                for e in enemies:
                    e.update(solids)
                    if e.alive and not player.dead and not player.invincible:
                        pr = player.get_rect()
                        er = e.get_rect()
                        if pr.colliderect(er):
                            if player.vy > 0 and player.y + player.h - e.y < 20:
                                e.squish()
                                player.vy = -8
                                score += 200
                                play_snd('stomp')
                                add_score_popup(e.x, e.y, "200")
                            else:
                                player.die()
                                if player.dead:
                                    lives -= 1
                                    if lives <= 0:
                                        state = STATE_GAMEOVER
                                    else:
                                        state = STATE_DEATH
                                        death_timer = 90

                # ── coin collection ──
                for c in coins:
                    c.update()
                    if not c.collected and not player.dead:
                        p_rect = rect_of(player)
                        c_rect = pygame.Rect(c.x - c.r, c.y - c.r, c.r*2, c.r*2)
                        if p_rect.colliderect(c_rect):
                            c.collected = True
                            coins_count += 1
                            score += 100
                            play_snd('coin')
                            add_particles(c.x, c.y, YELLOW, 4)

                # ── powerups ──
                for pu in powerups[:]:
                    if not pu.active:
                        continue
                    pu.update(solids)
                    p_rect = rect_of(player)
                    pu_rect = pygame.Rect(pu.x, pu.y, pu.w, pu.h)
                    if p_rect.colliderect(pu_rect):
                        pu.collect(player)
                        powerups.remove(pu)
                        score += 1000
                        play_snd('powerup')
                        add_score_popup(pu.x, pu.y, "1000")

                # ── block bumping ──
                head_rect = player.get_head_rect()
                for b in blocks:
                    if b.type in ('brick', 'question') and not b.hit and not b.broken:
                        if head_rect.colliderect(pygame.Rect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h)):
                            b.hit = True
                            b.bump_y = -8
                            if b.type == 'question':
                                spawn_powerup(b.x, b.y - TILE)
                                play_snd('bump')
                                add_score_popup(b.x, b.y, "50")
                                score += 50
                                coins_count += 1
                            elif b.type == 'brick':
                                if player.big:
                                    b.broken = True
                                    add_particles(b.x + TILE//2, b.y + TILE//2, BRICK_COLOR, 8)
                                    play_snd('bump')
                                    score += 50
                                else:
                                    play_snd('bump')

                # ── flagpole ──
                if flag and not player.win:
                    pr = player.get_rect()
                    fr = pygame.Rect(flag.x, flag.y, flag.w, flag.h)
                    if pr.colliderect(fr):
                        player.win = True
                        player.vx = 0
                        state = STATE_WIN
                        score += 5000
                        play_snd('flag')

            else:
                # player is dead, handle death animation
                pass

            # update solids animations
            for b in blocks:
                b.update()

            # update powerups
            for pu in powerups:
                pu.update(solids)

        # ── DEATH STATE ──
        if state == STATE_DEATH:
            if death_timer > 0:
                death_timer -= 1
                if death_timer == 40:
                    player.vy = -10
                player.vy += GRAVITY
                player.y += player.vy
            else:
                if lives <= 0:
                    state = STATE_GAMEOVER
                else:
                    state = STATE_DEATH_ANIM
        elif state == STATE_DEATH_ANIM:
            # handled by player.update
            pass

        # ── DRAW ──
        screen.fill(SKY_COLOR)
        cam_x = int(camera.x)

        # blocks
        for b in blocks:
            b.draw(screen, cam_x)

        # coins
        for c in coins:
            c.draw(screen, cam_x)

        # powerups
        for pu in powerups:
            pu.draw(screen, cam_x)

        # enemies
        for e in enemies:
            if not e.alive:
                continue
            e.draw(screen, cam_x)

        # particles
        for p in particles:
            p.draw(screen, cam_x)
        popups[:] = [p for p in popups if p.life > 0]
        for p in popups:
            p.update()
            p.draw(screen, cam_x)

        # player
        player.draw(screen, cam_x)

        # HUD
        draw_hud()

        # game over / win text
        if state == STATE_GAMEOVER:
            go = big_font.render("GAME OVER", True, RED)
            screen.blit(go, (SCREEN_W//2 - go.get_width()//2, SCREEN_H//2 - 30))
            rtext = font.render("Press R to Restart", True, WHITE)
            screen.blit(rtext, (SCREEN_W//2 - rtext.get_width()//2, SCREEN_H//2 + 30))
        if state == STATE_WIN:
            win = big_font.render("YOU WIN!", True, YELLOW)
            screen.blit(win, (SCREEN_W//2 - win.get_width()//2, SCREEN_H//2 - 30))

        pygame.display.flip()
        await asyncio.sleep(0)

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
